items.title: On this day in space! Oct. 25, 1671: Astronomer Giovanni Cassini discovers Iapetus, Saturn's 'yin-yang' moon
items.text: On Oct. 25, 1671, the Italian astronomer Giovanni Cassini discovered a new moon at Saturn! Iapetus was the second moon anyone had ever found orbiting Saturn, and it was the first of four moons Cassini would discover at the ringed planet. The Dutch astronomer Christiaan Huygens had discovered Titan, the largest of Saturn's moons, about six years earlier.

items.title: Siberian Jay (Perisoreus infaustus) - Engerdal, NO
items.text: One of my most sought after lifers was the Siberian Jay they remind me of our Canada Jays but are far more shy! Unlike Canada Jays, Siberian Jay groups do not help raise another pair's young. They roam around in flocks and have a lovely rufous colour to their wings and tail. I thought of my dad a lot during this trip. It was a bird he grew up with while skiing in the mountains of northern Norway.
